name: renderChannel
purpose: Top-level PCM render/mix for a playback channel: when flag this+0x5c bit6 set calls renderChannelStreamed, when the channel is a single voice (this+0x5c bits) calls renderChannelSingle, otherwise loops the 16 sub-voice slots at this+0x2d4 (stride 0x110) calling renderChannelVoice on each armed one (this+0x58 bits 12..27).

name: renderChannelSingle
purpose: Renders one voice (the channel itself) into the output, picking the mixer by channel count (this+0x182==2 stereo), bit depth (this+0x18e==8) and the count param compared with 0xb (accumulate vs overwrite body); on loop/stop updates flags this+0x58/0x5c and posts 0x7eb to g_100b5038; returns 0x22 when count>2000.

name: renderChannelVoice
purpose: Renders one 0x110-byte sub-voice (param_1) into the output buffer, same mixer dispatch as renderChannelSingle (channel this+0x182/0x18e, param_4 compared with 0xb: accumulate vs overwrite), then advances the voice envelope/position fields at param_1+0x58/0xc0/0xf0 and handles loop restart.

name: renderChannelStreamed
purpose: Render path for a channel backed by a streaming decoder at this+0x54: pulls decoded PCM blocks via 0x10010660/0x100101a0 and mixes/resamples them into the output; returns 0x13 when this+0x54 is null.

name: mixAdd8bitStereo
evidence: callee of the mixer-pointer table (reached via pointer); shares the voice layout of renderChannelSingle
purpose: __cdecl(out,in,count,voice,mode) 8-bit to stereo interpolating mixer: reads 8-bit samples (*in*0x100-0x8000), linear-interpolates by the 16.16 phase at voice+0x1358 (mode1) / +0xb8 (mode0), scales by L/R volumes voice+0x1e8/+0x1f8 (mode1) / +0x78/+0x68 (mode0) and ADDS into the 16-bit output with 0x7fff/0x8000 saturation; sample buffer {+0x18 data,+0x1c len,+0x20 pos,+0x24 loop}.

name: mixCopy8bitStereo
evidence: callee of the mixer-pointer table (reached via pointer); shares the voice layout of renderChannelSingle
purpose: __cdecl(out,in,count,voice,mode) 8-bit to stereo interpolating renderer: same input/interpolation/volume handling as mixAdd8bitStereo but WRITES (overwrites) the 16-bit stereo output instead of accumulating.

name: WaveInDevice_dtor
purpose: Wave_In_Device destructor: reinstalls vtable 0x1005c604, if open/started (flag+4 bits1/2) waveInStop+waveInReset and WaveInDevice_close, then frees the WAVEHDR node list at +0x5c and the sub-objects.

name: WaveInDevice_prepareHeaders
purpose: Walks the WAVEHDR list at this+0x5c calling waveInPrepareHeader(this+0x44, hdr, 0x20) on each, translating MMRESULT into SNDERR codes; returns 0x13 when no list or no device handle.

name: WaveInDevice_unprepareHeaders
purpose: Walks the WAVEHDR list at this+0x5c calling waveInUnprepareHeader(this+0x44, hdr, 0x20) on each, translating MMRESULT into SNDERR codes; returns 0x13 when no list or no device handle.

name: mmioReadBuffered
purpose: thiscall(dst, n): mmioGetInfo on the HMMIO at this+0, memcpy up to n bytes out of the mmio read window (pchNext..pchEndRead) into dst, advances pchNext via mmioSetInfo; returns bytes copied.

name: mmioSeekToSample
purpose: Seeks the mmio stream to a sample position: clears flag bit1 at this+0x58, mmioSeek to (this+0x18c * blockAlign this+0x164 + dataStart this+0x174) then mmioAdvance to refill the I/O window.

name: Sound5c450_dtor
purpose: Destructor for the Sound/stream object (vtable 0x1005c450): walks the buffer-node list at this+0x17, mmioClose's each node's handle (+0x44) and unlinks it from the open-sound list g_100b49c8 (updating g_100b49cc/d0/d4), decrementing g_100b4a08.

name: Sound_resetBuffers
purpose: Resets the Sound stream: frees the decode buffer at this+2, zeroes the 0x12-dword MMIOINFO at this+3 and flags at this+0x16, and if the HMMIO at this+0 is open mmioClose's it, unlinks from g_100b49c8 and decrements g_100b4a08.

name: beginDecodeStreamA
purpose: thiscall(src): opens a decoder at this+0x54 via 0x10012fe0 (codec id 0x100e0, block size this+0x178), decodes the first block (0x100101a0), mmioReads the compressed data and feeds it to the decoder (0x10010370); sets this+0x58 bit28 and this+0x220=0x5622; returns 0x11/0x23 on failure.

name: beginDecodeStreamB
purpose: thiscall(src): like beginDecodeStreamA but requires src flag +0x6c bit3 and uses codec id 0x100f4; opens the decoder at this+0x54, primes the first decoded block and feeds the compressed data, setting this+0x58 bit28 and this+0x220=0x5622.

name: rewindChannel
purpose: Rewinds a channel for playback: clears flags this+0x16/0x17, mmioSeek's the stream to the data start (this+0x18c*blockAlign+this+0x174), mmioGetInfo/mmioAdvance to refill, resets the buffer descriptor at this[2] and the 16 sub-voice slots at this+0x95, then calls 0x10035460/0x10035340 to reset mix state.

name: Sound_stop
purpose: thiscall: if the Sound is playing (flag this+0x44 bit1) calls its virtual stop (vtbl+0x20) and sets this+0x58 bit3; otherwise frees the buffer-node list at this+0x5c (closing each node's mmio +0x44, unlinking from g_100b49c8) and decrements this+0x68.

name: Sound_freeBufferList
purpose: Frees the Sound's buffer-node list at this+0x5c: for each node mmioClose's the sub-object's handle (+0x44), unlinks it from g_100b49c8 (g_100b49cc/d0/d4), decrements g_100b4a08 and this+0x68.

name: freeMmioHandleList
purpose: Frees a singly-linked list of mmio-handle nodes at this+0x5c: mmioClose each node's handle (node+0), decrement g_100b4a08, free the node; clears this+0x74.

name: freeMmioHandleListGetInfo
purpose: Like freeMmioHandleList but mmioGetInfo's each node's handle before mmioClose (to flush the write buffer); frees the list at this+0x5c and decrements g_100b4a08.

name: streamReaderDtor
purpose: Destructor (vtable 0x1005c528): frees the mmio-handle node list at this+0x17, mmioClose each handle and decrement g_100b4a08.

name: fillDecodeRing
purpose: Advances/refills the decode ring buffer for a channel: reads the ring state at this[2] (+0x18 base,+0x14 size,+0x1c,+0x20) and write cursor this+0x4de masked by this+0x4dd, mmioSeek/mmioAdvance the source to pull the next block; returns 0x26 when flag this+0x58 bit5 is set.

name: randRange
purpose: Linear-congruential RNG step: state(this+0)=state*0x19660d+0x3c6ef35f, returns (state>>16)*(n&0xffff)>>16 (a random value in [0,n)).

name: SoundWindowObj_dtor
purpose: Non-deleting destructor for the sound message-window object (vtable 0x1005b8ac): if subclassed (flag this+4 bit2) restores the saved WNDPROC via SetWindowLongA(hwnd this+8,-4,this+0xc) and clears those fields.

name: pumpWaveMessages
purpose: Drains buffer-completion messages 0x7e8..0x7ef from the window at this+8 with PeekMessageA, dispatching each to soundWindowSubclassProc.

name: VoiceBase_ctor
purpose: Constructs a device/voice base object: sets default level this[2]=0x7f, zeroes fields, array-constructs 0x10 sub-objects of 0x18 bytes at this+9 (ctor 0x100020db), installs vtable 0x1005b914.

name: MidiDeviceBase_ctor
purpose: Constructs the Midi_Device base sub-object: default level this[2]=0x7f, zeroes this[1..7], installs vtable 0x1005b9e4.

name: WaveInDeviceBase_ctor
purpose: Constructs the Wave_In_Device base sub-object: default level this[2]=0x7f, zeroes this[1..7], installs vtable 0x1005ba5c.

name: stopSoundThreadFull
purpose: Stops the worker thread on a g_soundThreadState-layout struct: under the critical section (param+4) clears the running bit, SetEvent(param+0x24), Sleep(0) to yield, then clears both the thread-handle (param+0x20) and thread-id (param+0x1c) fields.

name: Sound_setSourceType
purpose: thiscall(type): stores the source type at this+0x54 and sets the matching format bits in this+0x44 (type1->4, 2->8, 4->0x10, 5->0x28, 6->0x100, 7->0x80).

name: Engine_playSound
purpose: thiscall(filespec): creates the Sound at this+0x40 via create_sound (or resets it via vtbl+0x60), opens it (vtbl+0x10), sets this+0x44 bit0 and starts playback (vtbl+0x7c); returns 1 when g_100b507c is 0.

name: Voice_setLevel
purpose: thiscall(level): stores the voice level as a double at this+0x58 (level*_DAT_1005b488) and a fixed-point copy at this+0x50 ((level+1)<<9), then recomputes the L/R pan gains via 0x10037f30(this,this+0x48).

name: Voice_setPanGains
purpose: thiscall(pan): clamps pan to [-0x40,0x3f] and stores it at this+0x48, then derives the left/right gain doubles and the fixed-point rate (clamped to 0x10000) from the level this+0x58 and this+0x50.

name: Channel_allocVoiceSlot
purpose: thiscall(*outIdx): scans the armed-voice bitmask (this+0x58>>12) for the first free (clear) bit 0..0xf, writes the index to *outIdx and returns the sub-voice slot address this+0x238+idx*0x110 (0 when all 16 busy).

name: Channel_findVoiceByTag
purpose: thiscall(tag): scans the 16 sub-voice slots at this+0x2d4 (stride 0x110) for an armed one (bitmask this+0x58>>12) whose tag field +0x48 equals the argument and that is not stopping (+0 bit3 clear); returns the slot address this+0x238+idx*0x110 or 0.

name: Voice_noteOff
purpose: fastcall(voice): if the two envelope doubles +0x58/+0xf0 are nonzero sets release flag +0x9c bit3, otherwise marks the voice finished (+0x9c bit2) and clears +0x94 bit0.

name: Channel_clearBackref
purpose: fastcall(channel): if the back-reference pointer at channel+0x13a4 is set, zeroes the pointee and the pointer.

name: Channel_startVoice
purpose: thiscall(idx 0..0x10): resets sub-voice idx (flags +0x2d4, position +0x2c0/0x2c4, copies default envelope/rate fields +0x254/0x328/0x32c/0x340) and computes its initial playback rate from this+0x1c0 and the engine g_100b4a20; returns 0xb when the channel is not armed.

name: Voice_stopAndFlag
purpose: thiscall(arg): calls 0x10035460(this,arg) then sets this+0x58 bit3 (stop requested).

name: Channel_recomputeVoiceGains
purpose: thiscall(rate): for each of the 16 sub-voices (stride 0x110) recomputes the two gain doubles at slot+0x4/0xc from the engine clock g_100b4a20 (vtbl+0x40) and the voice base rate slot-0x25.

name: Channel_setPanGains
purpose: thiscall(pan): clamps pan to [-0x40,0x3f], stores it at this+0x224 and derives the left/right fixed-point rates at this+0x1e8/0x1f8 from this+0x1d8 (clamped to 0x10000); at pan 0 both equal this+0x1d8.

name: serviceDecodeRing
purpose: fastcall(channel): if flag this+0x58 bit1 is set and bits 0x21 are clear, refills the decode ring via fillDecodeRing.

name: SoundGroup_stop
purpose: fastcall(group): calls the group's virtual stop (vtbl+0x5c), recursively stops and deletes the child sounds in the array at this+0x510 (count this+0x50e), then if flag this+0x32 bit1 flushes the embedded channel at this+0x1c via 0x100340b0; returns 0x14 otherwise.

name: SoundGroup_rewind
purpose: fastcall(group): calls the group's virtual reset (vtbl+0x40, arg this[1]) then rewinds the embedded channel at this+0x1c via rewindChannel.

name: SoundWindowObj_subclass
purpose: thiscall(hwnd): if not already attached (this+8==0) installs the subclass WNDPROC 0x100025ef via SetWindowLongA(hwnd,-4), saving the old proc at this+0xc, storing the HWND at this+8 and setting flag this+4 bit2; returns 0x18 on failure.

name: SoundWindowObj_unsubclass
purpose: fastcall(obj): if subclassed (flag obj+4 bit2) restores the saved WNDPROC via SetWindowLongA(obj+8,-4,obj+0xc) and clears obj+8/0xc and the flag bit.

name: Object_setName
purpose: thiscall(str): frees the old name at this+0x50 and stores a heap copy (strlen+new+strcpy) of str there; returns 10 when str is null.

name: Device_createAndStart
purpose: thiscall(filespec): create_sound at this+0x40 (returns 0xc if one already exists), sets the Sound's mode via vtbl+0x6c (arg from this vtbl+0x70) and starts playback via vtbl+0x7c.

name: Device_prepareSoundFlags
purpose: thiscall(filespec): ensures the Sound at this+0x40 exists (create_sound), then builds a mode-flag word from this+0x58 bits (0/8/0x10/0x40/2) plus vtbl+0x58, used to arm the voice.

name: Device_lazyCreateSound
purpose: fastcall(dev): if a filespec is present at dev+0x14, lazily create_sound at dev+0x10 and build the mode-flag word from dev+0x16 flags and vtbl+0x58; returns 8 when no filespec.

name: Device_createStartQueue
purpose: fastcall(dev): create_sound at dev+0x10, set mode (vtbl+0x6c), open (vtbl+0x84), and on success set dev+0x11 bit0, start (vtbl+0x7c) and queue the first buffer (vtbl+0x48).

name: Mixer_dtor
purpose: Destructor (vtable 0x1005bdd8 then base 0x1005bae0): frees the 0x28 voice-pointer slots at this+0x16 and the sub-object at this+0x14.

name: Channel_startVoiceTimed
purpose: thiscall(idx): if armed (this+0xc8 bit0) and not yet opened, opens via vtbl+0x10 and checks this+0x58 bit1; (re)starts the global SoundTimer g_100b49ec, calls Channel_startVoice on the embedded channel this+0x70, and if not playing (this+0xc8 bit6) sets it and starts output via vtbl+0x7c.

name: Sound5c450_ctor
purpose: fastcall(obj): runs the buildVoiceRxName base ctor, installs vtable 0x1005c450 (the Sound class, see Sound5c450_dtor), and zeroes the buffer-list fields (+0x5c..+0x68) and the 0x12-dword MMIOINFO at +0x6c.

name: StreamReader_ctor
purpose: fastcall(obj): runs the buildVoiceTxName base ctor, installs vtable 0x1005c528 (the streaming-reader class, see streamReaderDtor) and zeroes its buffer-list and ring fields (+0x5c..+0x90).

name: VoiceSlot_init
purpose: fastcall(slot): zeroes a 0x110-byte sub-voice slot (0x41 dwords from +0xc) and sets slot[0]=0, slot[1]=0, slot[2]=1.

name: MixBuffer_ctor
purpose: fastcall(obj): installs vtable 0x1005be84, zeroes 0x80 dwords and sets defaults obj+0x82=2, obj+0x86=0xfa.

name: allocVoiceSlot
purpose: thiscall(pair): operator_new(0x110) a sub-voice slot, VoiceSlot_init it and link it into the slot list using the {lo,hi} pair at param_1.

name: Voice_setName
purpose: thiscall(str): frees the old name at this+0x204 and stores a heap copy (strlen+new+strcpy) of str there.

name: Voice_setLoopFlag
purpose: thiscall(idx): sets the loop/active bits of sub-voice idx's flag byte at this+idx*0x110+0x2d4 (|4, clear bit1).

name: Voice_resetDefaults
purpose: fastcall(voice): clears the envelope/position fields and sets playback defaults - unity rate +0x50/0x68/0x78=0x10000 and gain 1.0 (+0x5c/0x64/0x74/0x84 = 0x3ff00000, the high dword of 1.0).

name: Channel_ctor
purpose: thiscall(obj): array-constructs the 0x10 sub-voice slots of 0x110 bytes at this+0x238 (element ctor Voice_resetDefaults), then zeroes the voice-list head/tail/count at this+0x1338..0x1354 and the MMIOINFO at this+0xc.

name: listAppendNodeA
purpose: thiscall(val): operator_new(0xc) a {prev,next,val} node and appends it to the doubly-linked list headed at this (head this[0], tail this[1], count this[3]).

name: listAppendNodeB
purpose: thiscall(val): byte-identical to listAppendNodeA (a second instantiation) - appends a new {prev,next,val} node to the doubly-linked list headed at this.

name: voiceListRemove
purpose: thiscall(voice): zeroes voice+0x20 and unlinks the list node whose value (+0x8) equals voice from the list at this+0x1338, freeing the node.

name: closeDecoder
purpose: fastcall(sound): if the decoder at sound+0x54 is present, closes it via 0x1000f760.

name: updateVoiceRate
purpose: fastcall(channel): recomputes the playback rate of the voice at channel+0x1390 from the engine clock g_100b4a20 (vtbl+0x40) and the base rate channel+0x1c0, writing the fixed-point step at voice+0xec.

name: serviceChannelPlayback
purpose: fastcall(channel): the per-tick service routine for a wave channel - returns 3 when no device g_100b49f0, otherwise advances the streaming decoder at channel+0x54 and the active voices from flags channel+0x58/0x5c.

name: loadMultiChannel
purpose: thiscall(filespec): parses the RIFF file into the embedded channel this+0x70 (parseRiffWave); if it is a multi-channel file (this+0x1438 in [2,3)) allocates the extra 0x1450-byte sub-channels at this+0x1440 (operator_new + ctor 0x1002b4e0).

name: SubChannel_ctor
purpose: fastcall(obj): constructs a sub-channel/mixer-voice object (vtable 0x1005bae0): sets default level obj[1]=0x7f, zeroes the descriptor fields obj[3..] and list fields obj+0x40..0x4c.

name: Channel_releaseBuffers
purpose: fastcall(channel): if the channel is open (flag+0x58 bit1) and not busy (flag+0x5c bit2) frees the buffer-node list at channel+0x4ce; returns 0xb when busy.

name: Channel_closeStreamList
purpose: fastcall(channel): walks the voice-stream list at channel+0x1390 (next pointer +0xb4), mmioClose each handle (+0x44), unlinks each from g_100b49c8 and decrements g_100b4a08.

name: Voice_setRateForward
purpose: thiscall(now): sets the voice's forward playback rate at this+0xec (fixed-point) and this+0xf0/0xf8 (double) from the level this+0x58 and the engine clock g_100b4a20 (vtbl+0x40).

name: Voice_setRateReverse
purpose: thiscall(now): like Voice_setRateForward but negates the rate (this+0xec = -step, this+0xf0/0xf8 negative) and sets this+0x60 - the reverse/ping-pong playback direction.
